summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its entry into a stock transfer agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of SWIFT JAPAN Co., Ltd., a childcare facility operator, for JPY454,580,040 (USD2,857,556) in cash. The acquirer's board approved the transaction on June 15, 2026. Prior to closing, SWIFT JAPAN will spin off investment assets to SWIFT ESTATE Co., Ltd. via an absorption-type company split, with LEIFRAS acquiring the remaining operating business. The expected closing date is July 1, 2026, subject to shareholder approval and customary conditions. What to watch: regulatory clearance and integration risk; the small deal size suggests limited arbitrage.
